objective: Establish that exact-session resume rejects a requested filename whose Session header has a different id.
claim: Filename/header identity mismatch is refused before provider or tool execution.

facts.selector: fails closed when the requested file id differs from the durable session header id
facts.observation: The Session loader rejects a durable header whose id differs from expectedSessionId.
The exact-session CLI binds the validated filename id into the Session load boundary. A failed load returns before startRepl, so model requests and tool execution do not begin.

facts.selector: fails actual resume closed on filename/header identity mismatch before any provider request
facts.observation: The production headless resume path points at a counting local endpoint, rejects the mismatch, emits no public event, and makes zero provider requests.
